The incumbent will be responsible for creating and maintaining enterprise reporting and analytics solutions using pharmacy health data. The incumbent will work on a multidisciplinary team of developers within the Enterprise Data and Analytics Department and will collaborate with other institutions across the University of California Health. The incumbent will use UCI Health software such as Crystal Reports, SSIS, SSRS, Tableau, Epic Reporting Workbench, Epic Radar, and the enterprise data warehouse to deliver high quality reports and analytic solutions. This includes quality metrics, regulatory requirements, and general clinical/operational reporting for outpatient pharmacies.
Must possess the skill, knowledge and ability essential to the successful performance of assigned duties
Knowledge of University and medical center organizations, policies, procedures and forms
Must demonstrate customer service skills appropriate to the job
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Ability to perform basic performance tuning to optimize queries to meet user needs
Ability to maintain a work pace appropriate to the workload
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across the Health System
